# Economy

> Currencies: atomic Add / Spend / Transfer backed by Data.

- Package: `Economy` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Economy")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Economy")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Economy`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/EconomyService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Economy = GaxiaServer.Economy
```

### Functions

- `Economy.Get(player: Player, currency: string): number`
- `Economy.Add(player: Player, currency: string, amount: number): boolean`
- `Economy.Spend(player: Player, currency: string, amount: number): boolean`
- `Economy.Set(player: Player, currency: string, amount: number): boolean`
  Admin override — bypasses Add/Spend clamps. Use sparingly (rewards, refunds).
- `Economy.Transfer(from: Player, to: Player, currency: string, amount: number): boolean`
  Atomic transfer between two players. Spend from sender first; only credit recipient if Spend succeeded so failure can't duplicate currency.

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Economy.OnTransaction` — `Signal<Player, string, number, number, TransactionKind>`
  (player, currency, delta, newBalance, kind)
